closeCard.headline: 说清楚
closeCard.lede: 分组选择是分类，级联选择才是上下级。先说名称、场景、面板何时关闭，再谈外观。

titleCard.headline: Name the dropdown
titleCard.lede: Opening downward is only the skin.

closeCard.headline: Say it this way
closeCard.lede: Grouped is filing. Cascader is parent-child. Name it, name the scene, and when the panel closes — then talk about looks.

lines.zh: 给下拉起对名字。先问清楚：选完交出去什么，菜单关不关。
lines.en: Name the dropdown. First ask: what do you hand over, and does the menu close?

lines.zh: 选择：一排选项里只交一个值，点中就关。
lines.en: Select: you hand over one value from a flat list, and the menu closes when you pick.

lines.zh: 多选择交的是一组。面板先开着，标签可以一个个摘掉。
lines.en: Multi-select hands over a set. The panel stays open, and you can peel tags off one by one.

lines.zh: 分组选择还是只交一个值。分组标题只是分类，不是上下级。
lines.en: Grouped Select still hands over one value. Group titles are filing, not parent and child.

lines.zh: 级联选择要一路点到不能再往下的那一级，才算选完。点开上一级只是展开，还不能当最终值。
lines.en: Cascader only finishes when you reach the last level you can pick. Opening a parent just expands it. That parent is not the final value.

lines.zh: 分割按钮的主体立刻做默认动作，只有箭头才打开不常用的菜单。
lines.en: On a Split Button, the main part does the default action at once. Only the arrow opens the less-used menu.

lines.zh: 巨型导航不是表单里的值，是多列导航。点链接，或点别的导航项。
lines.en: A Mega Menu is not a form value. It is multi-column navigation. Click a link, or another nav item.

lines.zh: 日期选择先入住再离店，过去的日子点不了。两端都齐了才是一段，晚数按日历天数算。
lines.en: A date range is check-in, then check-out. Past days cannot be picked. Only both ends make a span. Nights are calendar days.

lines.zh: 最容易混的一对：分组选择是分类，级联选择才是上下级。先说名称、场景和规则，再谈外观。
lines.en: The pair people mix up: Grouped is filing. Cascader is parent-child. Name it, name the scene, name the rule, then talk about looks.
